Resolve successful strict check-run to actual GitHub Actions workflow run and job; verify exact head, pull_request event, maintained validate-strict workflow path/name and successful job identity, retaining API evidence.

notes: Initial observation marked CI retention informational; this expanded operational finding assigns minor severity to the combined assurance contract per coordinator scope. Original observation remains immutable.
